'''DP-6 Guard Droid''' was a [[Security droid/Legends|security droid]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in use during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]] it protected the base of [[Darth Thanaton]] in the [[Museum of Corellian Industry]], where it was destroyed by Thanaton's rival [[Darth Nox|Kallig]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
DP-6 Guard Droid appears in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
